Results.ReviewText: Weber is quality product with quality assurance also assistance when needed
Results.Title: Weber the grill that outlast all others

Results.ReviewText: This is an amazingly compact, easy to control, great cooking, and cool-looking grill. It is just right for 2 to 4 people. We were told this compact grill is for tail-gate parties. I don't have a pickup, but I sure do like this. I'm glad the tornado blew the old, much bigger grill into the next county. Good timing on this little jewel, Weber!
Results.Title: Fabulous small grill.

Results.ReviewText: This a great little compact grill.  I purchased this for "on the go" grilling.  Camping, beach days and other day trips.  I have a ten pound tank I take as I tend to use this little guy a lot.  The removable and replaceable drip pan system is great and easy.  The cover is great to keep any little mess from dirtying your car or truck while traveling.  I have also dropped the tailgate in the driveway and cooked when I didn't want to fire up the charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Best compact grill I've owned.

Results.ReviewText: Good buy for the time used and recommend to my friends who like to cook outside. Especially fish.8
Results.Title: Use it often

Results.ReviewText: Great Small Grill. Using on small patio of an apartment. Also can take camping. Recommend purchasing small 5lb tank rather than camping cylinders for regular use
Results.Title: Great Small Grill

Results.ReviewText: Overall, a very good grill with the customer service to back it up. I wish that they made a heat blanket for it for cold weather use. The only downside of this grill is that it takes about 30 minutes to reach the grilling temperature.
Results.Title: Good Grill for one or two people!

Results.ReviewText:
Just purchased and used twice so far--Works well. Bought as a grill for RV'ing and I think it will work perfectly. Heats fast and leaves wonderful grill marks (follow instructions to heat the grates). Bought due to Weber name (I also have a Genesis which I love) and good reviews I have seen. Grill is quality, well made, and holds heat well. 
.
.
Results.Title: Great little grill with Weber quality

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased the Q1200 to replace a 10 pmus year old Q1000. The quality is still representative of Webers excellence in engineering and product pride. 
This unit is perfect for my wife and .yself and does the job when we  have guests.
Results.Title: The perfect not so little grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber gas grille. Though a tad smaller, it fits our lifestyle better (senior in a condo) and still packs the proper heat to grill our meats and sometimes corn on the cob.
Results.Title: Smaller but still packs grilling power

Results.ReviewText: It is a great little barbecue grill. We have another almost the same model. Had it for at least twenty years and it still runs great. We bought this second Weber because our eight burner barbecue finally rusted away. We set up two Webers and could cook just as much.
Results.Title: Great barbecue Grill, easy and fun to use.

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my existing Weber Q to get a working ignition switch and split grill. My old one had neither and I feared it would fail me but I didn’t want to risk being without it during the off season. I use my grill every month except Jan/Feb on a covered porch in Pgh.
Results.Title: My favorite purchase!

Results.ReviewText: My new Weber grill stopped lighting.  When I described what was happening the support team at Weber knew right away that the ignitor had gone bad.  Since the grill is still under warranty they shipped a new ignitor to me via FedX, Installation was a little awkward as I could have used a third hand.  But I got it done, and now it is working perfectly again.
Results.Title: Perfect warranty service

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for travel and camping. Easy to use and well made.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: It’s brand new, but seems to work really good so far. We have several grills ranging anywhere from the Genesis all the way to the Weber flat top and now the Weber Q
Results.Title: New q

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. So sorry to hear you are not able to attach the 1lb propane tank to the grill. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: You cannot use the 1 pound propane bottles with this grill. Making this grill not so portable. I have not found an adapter anywhere. Additionally the control and regular interfear with the right handle of the grill making it precarious to handle.
Results.Title: Buyer Beware!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. The Weber Q 1200 is compatible with both a standard disposable cylinder and can also accommodate a full-size, 20 lb. fuel tank when using an adapter hose #6501. We will be happy to reach out for further assistance.

Results.ReviewText: Had no idea this grill doesn't use my standard propane bottles.
Results.Title: Requires special size propane bottles

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear the grill came with the wrong lid. Our Care Team will reach out to ensure this issue has been resolved. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Haven’t used it yet,it came with the wrong lid.I alerted Weber of the issue it’ll be over a month if there estimate is true that I will get notification of when my replacement will be available.the one I have is blue but I stated any color would do(crickets)so I’m waiting for blue…
Results.Title: Weber grill 1200q

Results.ReviewText: The grates are heavy duty and disperse the heat well. They are easy to remove and clean.
Results.Title: Cooks great and is easy to clean

Results.ReviewText: We got it for travel in our motor home. It will be perfect !
Results.Title: Business owner

Results.ReviewText: GREAT little grill for on the go!  Heats up to temp fast and cooks like it's big brothers.
Results.Title: Awesome Little Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the quality of the grill with one exception. There should be a disable function to the ignition switch while the folding shelves are inside the grill. I burned my after lighting the grill with them unfolded. My bad but could be a simple fix.
Results.Title: Folding shelves

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Heats up quickly, super easy to clean
Results.Title: Best small grill ever

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill. Use it on our boat while cruising. Drip pan is great. Very easy to clean. Enamel covered cast iron grates work well.  We sit it on our Magma fish cleaning table. Easy to stow.
Results.Title: Best boat grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. Good for picnics or tailgating. It heats up quickly and is best for burgers and hotdogs. The grill seems to be well enough made that I hope to get a couple of seasons out of it. The temp control is probably not good enough for "low and slow" or doing an expensive steak. I do wish it had a way to lock the cover down for transport.
Results.Title: Great for burgers and hot dogs.

Results.ReviewText: Love the new grill. It is the perfect size for my wife and me. it's portability, especially with the optional stand is great and we can take it anywhere anytime.
Results.Title: The Q 1200, the perfect portable!

Results.ReviewText: Just picked up the Weber Q 1200 and it’s an easy 5 stars. The build feels solid, the lid and grates lock in heat fast, and it delivers even searing with zero flare-ups. Compact enough to toss in the trunk, yet big enough to cook for two to four without juggling batches. Ignition is instant, temp control is precise, and cleanup is quick thanks to the drip tray and porcelain-enameled grates. If you want a reliable, portable gas grill for road trips or small patios, this is it.
Results.Title: Perfect Travel Grill-Sturdy, Hot, and Hassle-Free

Results.ReviewText: easy to set up, maintain and quick to heat. Grill is good quality.
Results.Title: Good product

Photos.Caption: I’ll covered it up with a carrying case

Results.ReviewText:
I love this little grill so much. I live by myself so I thought it would be just the perfect size and it is. It was very easy to assemble. I converted from the small tank to the 20 gallon propane tank that was done with pretty much ease also that just 
adds a little cost to it. It would be nice if there was a conversion cable included. I found out it’s just as perfect when cooking for two. My gentleman friend has been over twice to cook on it and he really likes it too. It’s also handy to fold up and take with you for tailgating if you wish. I find it’s very easy to clean. Just be sure to spray it with oil before you start cooking and after you’ve cooked spray it with oil again, it takes a little effort, but it seems to clean up very easily all the way down to the drip pan you can remove the top plates. Let them soak for a little in a cleaning solution while you clean the interior cleaned up very nicely I also bought me a small carrying case cover. It was not actually a Weber, but it works perfectly just to keep it protected or to be able to carry it somewhere else if I wanted to I would highly recommend the purchase.
Results.Title: The perfect little grill

Results.ReviewText: Compact and fuss-free. Instant-on. Heats up quickly. Well-built. No complaints!
Results.Title: Quality Product

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Q grill I have and it is Great. Duranility is exceptional. The first one Q2000 has over 20 yrs. Just a great product.
Results.Title: The Best Grill

Results.ReviewText: Really good little grill.  Heat is very good; much better than cheap Cuisinart/etc. brants I've owned in the past. Only wish, is that the legs folded up to be more compact.
Results.Title: Really good little grill

Results.ReviewText: Did not expect no more or less than perfect.  The reason I bought this grill is because my Q-1000 has been running perfect for over 20 years riding on the back of rv.  You could make the grill grate stronger, I think I have replaced it once, lol....
Results.Title: Home base perfect grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this used for $20. It was trashed by the previous owner hence the price. Some oven cleaner and elbow grease, it cleaned up like brand new and is now one of my favorite grills. See before/after photos.
Results.Title: The best travel/tailgate grill

Results.ReviewText: Customer service at Weber is excellent. After  owning the bbq for one year, the regulator went. I think this is an issue with this bbq. But Weber sent us a new regulator right awy
Results.Title: Great customer service

Results.ReviewText: This grill heats up quickly and I am able to control the temp very easy- No need for a large grill anymore. 10 burgers no problem!,
Results.Title: The perfect grill
